name: race
description: Ancestries with culture, appearance, and suggested traits

fields.Name: Human
fields.Description: Highly diverse communities whose traditions emphasize adaptation, alliances, and rapid transmission of knowledge.
fields.Skill Bonus: Versatility: a bonus in one skill chosen at creation.
fields.Physical Ability: Adaptive endurance: better withstands abrupt changes of climate or pace.

fields.Name: Elf
fields.Description: A long-lived people with keen senses, attached to the memory of places and the distant consequences of decisions.
fields.Skill Bonus: Careful perception of natural and magical details.
fields.Physical Ability: Effective twilight vision in low light.

fields.Name: Dwarf
fields.Description: A people of builders whose communities define status through craft mastery and one’s given word.
fields.Physical Ability: Stability: better resists impacts and forced movement.

fields.Name: Orc
fields.Description: A robust people organized around community ties, public challenges, and a strong oral tradition.
fields.Skill Bonus: Intimidation or survival in hostile territory.
fields.Physical Ability: Physical power during a brief, intense effort.

fields.Name: Goblin
fields.Description: An ingenious people quick to turn waste, tools, and unexpected opportunities into useful solutions.
fields.Physical Ability: Small size: slips through narrow passages and cluttered cover.

fields.Name: Halfling
fields.Description: Travelers and rural communities valuing hospitality, discretion, and shared stories.
fields.Skill Bonus: Stealth in crowds or domestic settings.
fields.Physical Ability: Quick footing: keeps balance more easily.

fields.Name: Reptilian
fields.Description: A scaled people adapted to heat, long stillness, and humid environments.
fields.Skill Bonus: Tracking through marks, heat, and scent.

fields.Name: Fishfolk
fields.Description: An amphibious people living among coastal communities, reefs, and partly submerged cities.
fields.Skill Bonus: Navigation, fishing, and knowledge of currents.
fields.Physical Ability: Aquatic breathing and natural underwater movement.

fields.Name: Avian
fields.Description: A feathered highland people who prize currents, distances, and messages.
fields.Physical Ability: Gliding flight slows falls and crosses short gaps.

fields.Name: Sylvan
fields.Description: A plantlike or tree-bonded people whose memory passes through seasons and roots.
fields.Skill Bonus: Plant knowledge and communication with ecosystems.
fields.Physical Ability: Photosynthesis: light and water can sustain them briefly.

fields.Name: Slugfolk
fields.Description: A flexible people adapted to damp places, vertical surfaces, and hard-to-reach spaces.
fields.Skill Bonus: Detects substances through touch and taste.
fields.Physical Ability: Adhesion: moves slowly across very steep surfaces.

fields.Name: Beastfolk
fields.Description: Humanoid lineages sharing animal traits and traditions closely tied to their environment.
fields.Skill Bonus: Instinct and interaction with the related species.
fields.Physical Ability: One heightened animal sense chosen for the lineage.

fields.Name: Fairy
fields.Description: A small supernatural people bound to promises, emotions, and magically charged places.
fields.Physical Ability: Levitation or limited flight while lightly loaded.

fields.Name: Giant
fields.Description: A very large people whose homes, tools, and stories use an unusual scale.
fields.Skill Bonus: Strength work and knowledge of monumental terrain.
fields.Physical Ability: Far greater reach and carrying capacity.

fields.Name: Centaur
fields.Description: A nomadic people with humanoid torsos and quadrupedal bodies, adapted to open land and long travel.
fields.Skill Bonus: Land travel, tracking, and mounted combat.
fields.Physical Ability: Fast running on open terrain and great carrying capacity.
